name: BIG BOOM GRENADE
teaser: BigBoomGrenade (BBG) has a short fuse, just like my mate Dazza. A big explosion radius with LOTS of shrapnel.
description_html:
This mod adds an extra grenade called BigBoomGrenade (BBG)

It has a short fuse, just like my mate Dazza. A big explosion radius with LOTS of shrapnel.

It’s perfect for shredding enemies before they have a chance to run away, just don’t get too close!!

It is based from code by Echo55 and LumurkFox “PineappleBlitz”, so big thanks to them. I wouldn’t have known where

to start otherwise.

Just drop the file into the user/mods folder

Settings can be adjusted within the src\config folder and opening the config.ts file using Notepad++
